# Shared Game Audio (generated)

Creator: Muse (original compositions; no external or licensed music/melodies/assets).

## Files (generated by `tools/generate_game_audio.py`)

Music loops — mono 22050 Hz PCM16 little-endian WAV, layered bass/chords/melody:

- `practice_loop.wav` — quiet soft plucked learning melody; C major; 80 BPM, 8 bars 4/4, 24.000 s
- `cafe_loop.wav` — bright light chiptune, 110 BPM pentatonic ascending motifs + clear pulse; 8 bars 4/4, ~17.455 s
- `rain_loop.wav` — warm playful gentle jazzy major-seventh broken chords + brushed/simple percussion; 90 BPM, 8 bars 4/4, 21.333 s

Note: cafe/rain compositions exchanged on 2026-10-02 (file names retained).

SFX — mono 22050 Hz PCM16 little-endian WAV, soft timbres with smooth attack/release:

- `start.wav` (0.45 s) — two rising notes
- `hit.wav` (0.18 s) — short sparkle
- `error.wav` (0.40 s) — gentle descending two-tone (not an alarm)
- `combo.wav` (0.60 s) — ascending bright 3 notes
- `miss.wav` (0.30 s) — soft droplet chirp
- `finish.wav` (0.85 s) — cheerful short cadence

Sample format for all: mono, 22050 Hz, 16-bit PCM little-endian WAV.
Peak normalized to <= 0.85, nonzero RMS. Loops use overlapping notes with
wrapped tails plus short edge fades so the start/end seam is near zero.
Deterministic: fixed seeds; same command reproduces the same bytes.

Total of the 9 WAVs is under 5 MB.

## Reproduce

From the repository root:

    python3 tools/generate_game_audio.py --output-dir shared/audio

Optional preview montage (~9 s: 2 s of each track + 0.3 s of each SFX, padded):

    python3 tools/generate_game_audio.py --output-dir shared/audio --preview-file /tmp/audio_preview.wav

The preview file is a listening aid only, not an app asset.

Note: tests were not executed here (shell unavailable); the manager runs the
generator and its checks to render and validate the assets.
